turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Okay. I have about twenty minutes, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Before we go on, I'm recording this meeting.
Good. I'll want a copy of it, and I'm taking my own notes. Now, on the record, who decided on the zero?
And if you so much as mention legal action, I'm filing a harassment complaint through the union.

File it, and put it in writing. I haven't threatened anything, Hale; I asked who decided on the zero and whether anyone called me first. I'm going to the principal's office when we're done either way.
I always do. I'm writing that down, along with the time. What do you have, Hale?
